title: Git is not GitHub
concept: Local tool vs hosting website; your first GitHub repo and README

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Git is on your computer. GitHub is a website that hosts git repositories. Let's make a README and create a repo.

questions.prompt: Is this local repository connected to GitHub yet?
questions.explanation: We haven't connected it to any remote server yet.

recap: Git lives on your computer. GitHub is a website where you can host a copy of your project.
